sites.site: Integrated biologics and drug-product site (flagship, Bengaluru)

sites.approvals: USFDA, Health Canada, ANVISA, EU GMP (renewed FY26); USFDA inspection in Jun-2026

2.4bn capsules a year (from 0.8bn); site shared with Strides under a limited-period transition agreement; a greenfield plant is being planned
sites.approvals: USFDA, TGA, Health Canada, EMA, MHRA

capacity.expansion: US$100m capex programme, mostly cartridge lines: ~80% committed by Jul-2026. Line 2 commercial in Q2FY27, line 3 installed within FY27 (225 sterile days each; 675 in FY28), a fourth line later in FY28; new lines run 500-1,000L batches vs 200L on line 1 (2.5x output per day at 500L). Biologics: +5KL microbial and +4KL mammalian planned. Karnataka incentive of ~Rs70 cr approved in principle.

regulatory: 210+ audits since inception with a 100% success rate (Q4FY26 deck); 49 regulatory inspections and customer audits in FY26, 12 in Q1FY27 including two surprise USFDA audits at two sites
Flagship site: USFDA EIR after the Mar-2025 inspection; 'a very, very good inspection' in Jan-2026 (Q3FY26 call); EU GMP renewed; ANVISA approval for Brazil supply
SPD sterile site: EU GMP renewed (FY26); USFDA inspection in Jun-2026, outcome not public by 30-Sep-2026
EU GMP and TGA GMP certificates received across two sites in Q1FY27

guidance.current: FY28: ~US$400m organic revenue, ~40% steady-state EBITDA margin (~US$160m EBITDA), >50% ROCE excluding scheme goodwill and intangibles, net debt below 1.5x EBITDA; no FY27 number; 'Q4FY27 annualised exit run-rate a good reflection of near-close FY28 guidance' (Chairman, 24-Jan-2026)
history: May-2025: FY26 a 'transition year', guided ~30% growth (JM, 6-May-2025); FY28 US$400m at 38-40% margin
Nov-2025: FY28 raised to US$500m+ including the proposed Steriscience/Brooks acquisition (organic US$400m kept)
Jan-2026: Q3FY26 revenue -26% YoY on delayed Canadian semaglutide approvals; 'next two quarters relatively soft'; take-or-pay contracts deferred for some customers
May-2026: FY26 revenue -2% (vs ~30% guided); acquisition paused; FY28 US$400m organic reaffirmed
Jul-2026: Q1FY27 +37%; FY28 reaffirmed; sequential growth promised every quarter of FY27

scheme2025.what: Composite scheme to absorb Steriscience Specialties into Brooks Steriscience (listed carbapenem maker) and merge Brooks, Steriscience Pte (Singapore; EU fill-finish site in Poland) and Strides Pharma Services into OneSource; swap 137 OneSource shares per 10 Brooks and 53 per 100 Steriscience Pte shares; ~18.5% dilution; promoter stake to ~36%; incoming businesses US$107m revenue / US$39m EBITDA by FY27 (JM)
scheme2025.status: Exchange NOC 26-Feb-2026; on 13-May-2026 the board decided not to pursue it in its current form after some shareholders raised valuation concerns; to be revisited after FY28 guidance is delivered
scheme2025.src: q2deck pp.5-16; care; q4deck p.20; q4call; JM Financial (12-Oct-2025, investmentguruindia)

listing2025.scheme: Strides Pharma Science's soft-gel CDMO business and Steriscience Specialties' injectables CDMO business merged into Stelis Biopharma (renamed OneSource) under an NCLT-sanctioned scheme (order 14-Nov-2024), effective 1-Apr-2024; shares issued to Strides and Steriscience shareholders; Strides' own stake in OneSource cancelled
listing2025.preListingRaise: Rs801 cr raised in Nov-2024 from domestic and international investors at a ~US$1.65bn valuation (CARE)
listing2025.goodwill: Rs3,827.5 cr of goodwill and Rs1,393 cr of other intangibles (product portfolio, 10 years; marketing and manufacturing rights, 15 years) recognised on the combination; amortisation ~Rs137.8 cr a year (Rs34.4 cr a quarter)

management.cfo: Anurag Bhagania (CFO since Jul-2024; FY26 pay Rs2.8 cr)

litigation: Prestige Biopharma claims US$136.3m (Rs1,286 cr) from subsidiary Biolexis Pte over the terminated Sputnik Light vaccine manufacturing contract (SIAC arbitration); Biolexis denies liability and seeks a refund of a US$13.6m capacity fee; legal costs booked as exceptional items (FY26 Rs4.5 cr, Q1FY27 Rs4.3 cr)
